description: Loads environment variables using dotenv and defines system-wide constants, base directories (uploads, rendered pages, annotations, repositories), render resolutions (DPI), confidence thresholds, and model credentials (NVIDIA, Gemini, Qwen).
connections: Imported by app.py, core/pdf_processor.py, core/evidence_store.py, core/orchestrator.py, models/nvidia_client.py, models/qwen_client.py, and models/gemini_client.py to retrieve configurations.

description: Main user interface file. Ingests drawings, handles sheet navigation, and provides side panels for settings toggles and Reasoning Modes (Current Sheet, Smart Retrieval, Full Document). Renders multi-image and multi-sheet drawing views, displays grounded bounding box highlights on correct sheets, shows validation warning alerts, overlays layout regions, and renders explainability diagnostics via the DebugPanel.
connections: Imports config.py for settings, core/pdf_processor.py for ingestion, core/evidence_store.py for metadata, core/orchestrator.py for query reasoning, core/debug_panel.py for rendering logs, core/annotation_engine.py for bounds overlays, and core/session_memory.py for caching resolved terms.

description: Lists the required Python packages for running the project, including PyMuPDF, Pillow, Pydantic, Streamlit, Google GenAI SDK, Requests, and EasyOCR.
connections: Used by developers during installation (pip install -r requirements.txt).

description: Stores local secrets, API keys (GEMINI_API_KEY, NVIDIA_API_KEY), custom api endpoints, default active models, render DPI configuration, and confidence check thresholds.
connections: Parsed by config.py to populate variables at runtime.

description: A template/sample configuration file demonstrating the shape and keys of the required environment parameters for new environments.
connections: Copied to create the actual active .env file.

description: Markdown document recording major architectural decisions, technical justifications, design trade-offs, and verification weights for the upgrades.
connections: Used as system architecture design documentation.

description: Contains installation, configurations, troubleshooting tips, list of key features, sample question categories, and a Mermaid diagram describing the architecture flow.
connections: Used as the primary documentation entry point for developers.

description: Short diagnostic script configuring a hardcoded Gemini API key and listing available models supporting generateContent via the legacy SDK.
connections: Used by developers for manual key validation.

description: Checks imports and versions of modules, verifies PyTorch GPU CUDA accessibility, checks PaddleOCR initialization, and inspects the local Ollama tags endpoint to list installed models.
connections: Run by developers to diagnose server/environment health.

description: Empty initialization file marking the core/ directory as an importable Python package.
connections: Allows package-level importing of modules inside the core directory.

description: Uses PIL (Pillow) to draw colored semi-transparent bounding box overlays outlining identified layout regions: notes (Blue), legend (Green), title block (Purple), and drawing area (Orange), including readable text labels.
connections: Called by app.py when visual layouts overlays are enabled in the UI.

description: Computes evidence-based scores using intent-specific formulas. Enforces consistency capping rules (e.g. capping at 0.69, 0.59, or 0.49) based on OCR matches and review status, but bypasses capping when visual grounding is present (has_bbox == True). Logs consistency audits.
connections: Called by core/orchestrator.py to rate answers.

description: Legacy context retrieval routing searches to pull OCR elements matching specific layout regions or keywords. Replaced by ContextBuilder in the document-aware pipeline.
connections: Used by legacy routines to pull localized page-only contexts.

description: Extracts counting objects, checks OCR occurrences, and adjusts counting confidence. Replaced by CountingEngine in the document-aware pipeline.
connections: Used for legacy counting validations.

description: Renders Streamlit UI elements for the Debug Control Board. Parses JSON responses and applies regex stripping fallbacks to format stated answers, displays page classifications, detailed page ranking keyword/tag/symbol matches, counting consensus audits, and confidence consistency warning details.
connections: Imported and called by app.py.

description: Consolidates and manages document repository structures. Exposes query methods: fuzzy search, nearest-coordinate distance search, region intersection queries, and text sequence phrase matching.
connections: Queried by app.py, core/context_retriever.py, core/counting_handler.py, core/validator.py, and core/orchestrator.py.

description: Scales normalized coordinates and draws green highlights over referenced bounding boxes on high-resolution page images.
connections: Called by core/orchestrator.py to generate annotated results images.

description: Applies heuristics based on indicator terms and coordinate boundaries to segment drawings into Legend, General Notes, Title Block, and Drawing Area.
connections: Called by core/pdf_processor.py to attach identified region layout metadata to the repository.

description: Compares textual answer similarity (Jaccard) and coordinate overlaps (Intersection-over-Union IoU) between primary and verification models to generate a model agreement score.
connections: Called by core/orchestrator.py during multi-model verification runs.

description: Performs OCR text detection on page images (using EasyOCR or PaddleOCR, falling back to PyMuPDF's embedded text). Links each word token to its bounding box coordinates and evidence type.
connections: Called by core/pdf_processor.py to extract text words.

description: Main pipeline controller for query execution. Directs intent classification, page ranking (retains layout context but filters drawing pages), context building, memory caching, model execution, agreement checks, counting audits, consistency capping, and grounding. Handles native multi-image prompts, coordinates fallback routing for single-image clients, tracks primary image pages, and ensures grounded boxes map to the correct drawing sheet.
connections: Interlinks core/question_analyzer.py, core/page_ranker.py, core/context_builder.py, core/session_memory.py, models/nvidia_client.py, models/gemini_client.py, models/qwen_client.py, core/model_verifier.py, core/counting_engine.py, core/validator.py, core/confidence_engine.py, and core/grounding_engine.py.

description: Hashes PDFs to check cache. Renders pages as high-resolution images via PyMuPDF (fitz), triggers layout extraction and OCR text detection, runs document intelligence, and serializes the parsed repository to disk. Auto-upgrades older cached v1.0/v2.0 schemas to populate page classifications.
connections: Called by app.py when a drawing is uploaded, calls core/layout_extractor.py, core/ocr_engine.py, core/document_intelligence.py, and core/evidence_store.py to construct the document repository.

description: Uses regex classifiers to determine user query intents (counting, legend, notes, conflict, location, equipment, title_block, schedule, specification, abbreviation, cross_sheet, revision, general) and maps the query to custom templates.
connections: Called by core/orchestrator.py to analyze incoming questions before context search.

description: Validates coordinate boundary ranges [0.0, 1.0], checks page number consistency, and flags OCR cross-verification warnings if terms are absent in OCR.
connections: Called by core/orchestrator.py to validate response bounds.

description: Extracts document-wide metrics, classes, and properties once upon ingestion. Runs a multi-dimensional scoring-based classifier for each page to assign a mutually exclusive page_type (cover, legend, notes, schedule, drawing, title_block, mixed), indexes legend/notes pages, and extracts equipment tags, symbols, abbreviations, and specifications.
connections: Called by core/pdf_processor.py when parsing a PDF. Output cached inside the DocumentRepository.

description: Computes relevance scores [0.0, 1.0] for all pages based on text keywords, equipment tags, symbol alignments, and intent sheet classes. Applies scoring offsets for counting queries (+0.40 for drawing pages, -0.25 for legend pages, -0.50 for cover pages) and exposes detailed keyword/tag/symbol matches diagnostics.
connections: Called by core/orchestrator.py to target searches to specific relevant sheets.

description: Assembles structured prompts based on intent. Formats OCR elements in reading order (sorted by ymin, then xmin) using standard [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] text representation. Prepends descriptive sheet headers and always injects definition pages context (legend and notes sheets containing definitions and symbols) before drawing context for every query intent.
connections: Called by core/orchestrator.py to package relevant context.

description: Caches resolved symbols, abbreviations, and equipment specs across user queries and prepends them as project context for matching terms. Automatically resets on new uploads.
connections: Instantiated and updated in app.py, read inside core/orchestrator.py.

description: Performs audits comparing stated counts against visual bounding boxes, OCR matching words, and verifier model consensus. Strips question keywords and singularizes target nouns to extract counting targets. Dynamically resolves standard/legend engineering abbreviations and symbol shorthands using OCR text from legend regions on legend pages rather than hardcoded lists, filters out inline legends and legend pages from counting pools, and tracks matches uniquely.
connections: Called by core/orchestrator.py to verify counting questions.

description: Empty initialization file marking the models/ directory as an importable Python package.
connections: Allows package-level importing of modules inside the models directory.

description: Interfaces with NVIDIA's chat completions API. Encodes images to base64, features asynchronous polling for 202 Accepted codes, and normalizes plain text, percentages (e.g. '85%'), nulls, and alternate reasoning keys to valid InterpretationResponse schemas.
connections: Imported and instantiated by core/orchestrator.py as the primary (Tier 1) model reasoning client.

description: Interfaces with Google's gemini-2.5-flash model via the google-genai SDK. Supports native multi-image prompt payloads (sending multiple PIL images in a single call) and applies response normalization to handle confidence strings and reasoning key mapping safely.
connections: Imported and instantiated by core/orchestrator.py as the secondary (Tier 2) fallback and validation client.

description: Interfaces with a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama) to query qwen2.5-vl, falling back to smolvlm/smolvlm2. Applies response normalization to handle confidence strings and reasoning key mapping safely.
connections: Imported and instantiated by core/orchestrator.py as the local fallback (Tier 3) and verification client.

description: Empty initialization file marking the schemas/ directory as an importable Python package.
connections: Allows package-level importing of modules inside the schemas directory.

description: Defines Pydantic models for DocumentRepository, PageEntry, LayoutRegion, OCRElement, and PageDimension. Updated to v2.0 to support cached document intelligence.
connections: Used by core/evidence_store.py, core/pdf_processor.py, and OCR modules to serialize/deserialize drawings.

description: Defines Pydantic model InterpretationResponse containing answer, confidence, page number, bbox coordinates, evidence flags, and reasoning fields.
connections: Used by clients and core orchestrator to validate and store model outputs.

description: Empty initialization file marking the prompts/ directory as an importable Python package.
connections: Allows package-level importing of modules inside the prompts directory.

description: Holds the base system instructions and custom reasoning prompt structures for each question type.
connections: Loaded by core/orchestrator.py and passed to model clients.

description: Holds the system instructions for model prompts.
connections: Imported by models/gemini_client.py and models/qwen_client.py.

description: Empty initialization file marking the tests/ directory as an importable Python package.
connections: Allows package-level importing of modules inside the tests directory.

description: Unit tests for all subsystems (PDF, layout, OCR, verifier, analyzer, retriever, counting, confidence, and NVIDIA client). Extended to test all document-aware reasoning engines and response normalizations (44 tests total).
connections: Standalone script executed to verify correctness.
